doc.title: Grover Mitchell interviewed by Monk Rowe, Sarasota, Florida, February 13, 1996

title: Becoming a leader
summary: Mitchell enjoys leading, had his own band after leaving, and feels his apprenticeship prepared him.

story.theme_name: Leading a band: choosing, paying and managing players
story.community_name: Leading a band: running, choosing and keeping players

blocks.x: Do you enjoy being the leader?

Yes. I got to the place where I just figured I was the leader. I didn’t want to do anything else. I had my own band after I left this band. And I feel that I grew into this role. I know that might sound a little bit — I don’t want it to sound arrogant but I didn’t want to be a sideman anymore. I figured that what I was able to do now, my contribution would be better as a leader. I think I know what I’m doing, and I think my long apprenticeship has pretty well prepared me for this.
